crossRefs.note: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

translations.web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”
translations.bsb: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?”
translations.kjv: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
translations.asv: He saith unto them, But who say ye that I am?
